narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.45 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.008539-0.008822 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.008883; the first objective pays 0.87R at 0.008464.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.008883 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.97 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 27/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $14.7M -2.2% below · short liq $10.2M +3.6% above
